definition: This is a connection-readiness map, not a market-data feed. A listed capability does not mean that the dashboard has retrieved, stored, displayed, or licensed that provider's data.

providers.name: Company IR and SEC filings
providers.description: This is the current expectations baseline. It supplies company-issued outlook and reported results, not analyst consensus or a valuation feed.
providers.sourceLabel: SEC EDGAR and company investor relations

providers.name: Financial Modeling Prep
providers.status: Not connected · written display rights required
providers.description: Technically suited to the compact watchlist. Do not publish, archive, or render its values here unless the agreement explicitly covers this public static site and its downloadable data files.

providers.name: Intrinio Estimates
providers.description: Its EPS estimates product is presented as enterprise-only. A future order form must also specify public display and data-retention rights before any integration.

providers.name: S&P Capital IQ Estimates
providers.description: An institutional route for a durable expectations and revisions history. Licensing, delivery format, and public-display rights remain to be evaluated.

providers.name: LSEG I/B/E/S
providers.description: An institutional route when deep history and broad estimate coverage become research requirements. Licensing and delivery terms remain to be evaluated.

providers.name: FactSet Estimates
providers.description: An institutional route that combines estimates, actuals, guidance, and analyst context. Licensing and a suitable data-feed agreement remain to be evaluated.

providers.name: Finnhub
providers.description: Its API capability is relevant, but personal plans prohibit sharing or redistributing data or derived results without written approval. Do not use it for this public site without that approval.
